title: rubus serpens var. incultus
intro: Rubus serpens var. incultus, commonly known as wild raspberry, is a plant species within the Rubus genus. It is known for its edible fruits, which are rich in nutrients and have been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of wild raspberry include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Rubus serpens var. incultus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
